tactics:
induction l generalizing l' i with
| nil => simp at h'
| cons a as ih =>
  cases l' with
  | nil => simp at h'
  | cons b bs =>
    cases i with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ i => exact ih bs i (by simp [List.length_zipWith] at h' ⊢; omega)
induction l generalizing l' i <;> cases l' <;> cases i <;> simp_all [List.zipWith]

induction l generalizing l' i with
| nil => simp at h'
| cons a as ih =>
  cases l' with
  | nil => simp at h'
  | cons b bs =>
    cases i with
    | zero => simp [List.zipWith]
    | succ i => simp only [List.zipWith, List.getElem_cons_succ]; apply ih
